name: W Santiago
positioning: A bold, design-led hotel in Santiago's El Golf district with Tony Chi-designed rooms and a 21st-floor rooftop bar looking out to the Andes
best_for: Design lovers who want rooms with murals, jewel tones and velvet or leather accents
Travelers who want a rooftop bar with Andes and city views

facts.text: The hotel is in El Golf, Santiago.
The hotel describes itself as a five-star hotel.
Red2One is on the 21st floor at the top of the hotel.
Karai blends Peruvian and Japanese cuisine using high-quality local Chilean products.
The hotel has an outdoor pool, WET.
The hotel has a Bio Ritmo fitness center.
Pets are welcome, with a pet welcome kit and custom pet bed.
Whatever/Whenever service handles guest requests big or small.

highlights.text: Red2One is a rooftop bar with panoramic views of the Andes Mountains and the city of Santiago.
Guest rooms were conceived by designers Tony Chi and Sergio Echeverria, inspired by the surrounding city.
Rooms feature sleek decor, plush velvet or leather accents, large-scale abstract murals and lucite light fixtures.
The one-bedroom Penthouse II blends Chilean colors, art and flavors with modern European sensibilities.
The hotel combines daring design with a vibrant color palette.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes the modern design may not appeal to travelers who prefer traditional luxury.
WhataHotel notes pricing reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
